translations.web: You will be established in righteousness. You will be far from oppression, for you will not be afraid, and far from terror, for it shall not come near you.
translations.bsb: In righteousness you will be established, far from oppression, for you will have no fear. Terror will be far removed, for it will not come near you.
translations.kjv: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near
translations.asv: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression, for thou shalt not fear; and from terror, for it shall not come near thee.
